overview.description: ETRACS Alerian MLP Infrastructure Index ETN is an exchange traded note launched by UBS AG (Jersey). The note seeks to track the performance of the Alerian MLP Infrastructure Index. The index represents the public equity markets. It represents master limited partnerships that are engaged in the energy sector and involved in the transportation, storage, and processing of energy commodities. The index represents master limited partnerships across all market capitalizations. The ETN will mature on April 2, 2040. ETRACS Alerian MLP Infrastructure Index ETN was formed on March 31, 2010 and is domiciled in Switzerland.
